concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-business-accounts-verification-requirements-data-formats-per-country]] — 2024-modified, 2026-09-15-captured country/entity data-format tables for verification inputs across Platforms and Issuing; rows are examples, not Business Accounts eligibility or KYC approval.
warnings: The seven country tables and entity/ID examples are input-format references, not universal required fields, product availability, legal eligibility or completed KYC.
The page's no-additional-requirements sentence applies to using this reference with Platforms or Issuing, not to Business Accounts onboarding generally.

General optional separator language has a field-specific Germany tax-ID exception requiring slash removal; preserve table detail and awkward compound Spain alternatives as captured rather than silently normalizing.
